parsed.why: Listed among worst for anti-trans legislation; all birth-certificate changes banned forcing document outing; state-facility bathroom restrictions; no state discrimination or hate-crime cover. Below parent on tier-1 facility and thin-recourse exposure.

Worst-Policies-In-Effect tier: extended bathhouse ban plus misdemeanour for adult facility use, first state care ban, religious service denial, X-marker rescinded, no hate-crime cover. Criminal exposure puts it below parent.

Low-risk group, no facility ban, 2013 gender-identity protections in public accommodations, hate-crime penalty enhancement, provider-letter marker change, LGBTQ commission. Only national document and entry regime holds it below higher tiers.

First state to repeal gender-identity civil-rights protection, then pre-empted stronger city ordinances; school facility rule binds visitors by birth certificate. State hostility plus removed recourse outweighs no-criminal-penalty factor.

Second-highest risk tier but facility law has no enforcement mechanism; birth-certificate corrections work, employment executive order and 33 municipal ordinances give partial recourse against narrowing 2026 licence rules. Roughly parent level.
